entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mirza Ebrahim Khan Akkas Bashi was an Iranian photographer and cinematographer. He became the first cinematographer of the country on 15 August 1900, when he recorded Mozaffar ad-Din Shah Qajar strolling on the beach of the town of Ostend in Belgium.
